item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-10
item.description: China accelerates the OSSification of industrial infrastructure: the OpenAtom Foundation launches its Control Systems Open Source Community on the industrial-software conference stage; Anolis (OpenAnolis) donates itself to OpenAtom and rebrands as 'AI-native'; The Diplomat charts WAICO's institutional agenda in the West's absence; KAIYUANSHE publishes its 2026 board of directors.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-09
item.description: DeepSeek resumes its $8B funding round at a $74B valuation as Monolith — the same Chinese backer behind Moonshot AI — enters negotiations; TechNode reports DeepSeek plans significant API price increases; OpenAtom Foundation publishes the AIP Agent Interconnection Protocol on its domestic AtomGit platform, operationalizing China's first national standard for AI agent interconnection; Monolith announces a $500M new fund.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-29
item.description: Kimi K3 open-source model challenges closed-source AI dominance; OpenAtom 'Park Tour' Hong Kong Station launches openEuler's first overseas regional community.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-28
item.description: CCF ChinaOSC 2026 preview: Xenomai real-time OS for embodied intelligence; OpenAtom Deep Report finds AI open source entering 'ecosystem decisive' era; CR Power's RunDianHong IoT OS for power systems.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-27
item.description: 70+ local open source policies mark China's shift to 'value realization' phase; Zhejiang's 7-department open source system plan; Embodied AI's open source moment with 3M+ OpenLET dataset downloads; OpenAtom prepares AI Agent working group.
